note: Contract DATA only, not an admitted manifest. Missing values and unreviewed/proposal status refuse before raw/actor. Root independently joins archive audit, original111 baseline namespace and actual ALPM metadata preparation.

manifest_fields.archives: object keyed package name; sorted key iteration; exactly the proposed minimal additions, no111 replacement

keyring.pin: {bytes,sha256} of retained original PUBLIC binary keyring

manifest_fields.baseline_metadata: object keyed exact111 name; row {version,directory,provides:[expressions],files:[relative package-owned paths]}
manifest_fields.baseline_metadata_provenance: nonempty object with exact prepared/raw/rootfs-index/selection pins and original signed ownership/provides association method
manifest_fields.metadata_prepare: unchanged actual proposal.metadata_prepare object (libalpm16.0.1 PASS,111 protected, no errors/removals/questions/conflicts); includes dependencies rows {package,provider,relation}
manifest_fields.original_file_pins: absolute baseline path -> SHA256; required four PAM files, stock71-seat.rules and every required namespace leaf supplied by baseline
manifest_fields.required_namespace: relative guest path -> {owner:package,payload:<actual package payload record>}

archive_row.expected_signer: 40 uppercase hex actual original VALIDSIG primary signing fingerprint
archive_row.source_provenance: nonempty original catalog/source/audit association object; never self-created approval
archive_row.metadata: FULL actual .PKGINFO multimap string->list[string]; preserves field/dependency order, metadata must equal independent archive parse

payload_record.type: tar type as ASCII string (regular '0', symlink '2')
payload_record.sha256: hex for regular files, null for links/directories
payload_record.link: original linkname, empty string for regular files
payload_record.ELF: include exact elf_geometry projection for ELF leaves: machine:aarch64, LOAD records or relocatable fields. Existing package_data.py constructs this projection; it never executes an ELF.

required_namespace.usr/bin/python3: owner python (may be original symlink payload record)
required_namespace.usr/lib/girepository-1.0/Gio-2.0.typelib: actual regular provider, baseline allowed with baseline owned-files+hash association
required_namespace.usr/lib/girepository-1.0/GLib-2.0.typeli: actual regular provider, baseline allowed with baseline owned-files+hash association
